backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister actor with storage mixins, access control, constants, and a large set of user-related types and maps for tasks, notes, reminders, timers, profiles, coins, and study tracking.
backend/migration.mo: Implements a migration that upgrades old task, reminder, and user profile data structures to new versions with added fields like tags, noteId, and dailyStudyGoal.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature IDs, related frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides predefined one‑sentence summaries for various frontend components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up metadata, icons, and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication, background settings, and tab‑based navigation for all feature sections.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundSettin: Provides UI for selecting, uploading, and purchasing background images with coin-based restrictions and optional camera capture.
frontend/src/components/DailyGoalProgres: Displays and edits the user's daily study goal while showing progress based on today's completed study sessions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a simple footer with attribution and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Shows the app header with theme toggle, authentication controls, and user profile avatar with dropdown menu.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Displays the login page with feature highlights and triggers Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/MonthlyStudySumm: Shows monthly study stats including total minutes and best week, allowing navigation between months.
frontend/src/components/NoteLinker.tsx: Provides UI for linking, creating, and unlinking notes, including dialogs for selecting or creating notes and callbacks for parent components.
frontend/src/components/NotesSection.tsx: Manages full CRUD for notes with support for images, voice notes, editing, and deletion, using multiple dialogs and media handling.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSection.t: Displays and edits the user profile, including bio, display name, avatar upload/removal, level progression, and study statistics.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Initial profile setup dialog allowing users to set name and bio and triggering profile creation with a welcome reward.
frontend/src/components/ReminderNotifica: Schedules and displays browser notifications for upcoming reminders, tracking notified reminders via session storage.
frontend/src/components/RemindersSection: Provides CRUD interface for reminders, including date/time validation and optional note linking via the NoteLinker component.
frontend/src/components/RewardShopSectio: Implements a virtual shop with categorized items, coin balance checks, purchase dialogs, and owned-item tracking.
frontend/src/components/StopwatchSection: Provides a persistent stopwatch with backend sync, state restoration, time formatting, and start/pause/reset controls.
frontend/src/components/StudyHeatmapView: Generates a 90‑day study heatmap by computing daily minutes from session data and mapping intensity to colors with tooltips.
frontend/src/components/TimerSection.tsx: Implements a Pomodoro/custom timer with persistence, notifications, session recording, streak display, and UI controls.
frontend/src/components/timetable/DoneTo: Checkbox component that toggles and displays whether a timetable entry has been completed today.
frontend/src/components/timetable/EditTi: Dialog for editing a timetable entry’s title and activity type while showing read‑only schedule data.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Dialog showing last six months of daily completion history for a timetable entry, including stats and a scrollable list.
frontend/src/components/TimetableSection: Manages timetable entries including creation, editing, deletion, and viewing completion history with validation and dialogs.
frontend/src/components/TodoSection.tsx: Complex task manager UI handling creation, editing, filtering, and deletion of tasks with tags, priorities, and optional linked notes.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyStudyTimeG: Displays aggregated weekly study session durations using a stacked bar chart with totals for each session type.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines multiple React Query hooks wrapping actor-based backend calls for profile, coins, and other user actions with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes with global base styles.
frontend/src/lib/NotificationManager.ts: Provides a notification manager using toast and browser notifications with fallbacks and permission handling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrorMessage.t: Maps raw backend error strings to cleaner user-facing error messages.
frontend/src/utils/timetableDates.ts: Utility functions for generating date keys and checking whether timestamps fall on today.
frontend/src/utils/timetableHistory.ts: Builds day ranges and maps timetable ticks to daily completion for the past six months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/src/utils/weeklyStudyGraph.ts: Aggregates study sessions into the last seven days of per-type minute totals.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending themes with OKLCH-based colors, layout settings, and animation utilities.
project_state.json: Tracks project version, expanded feature scope, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of existing feature requirements. Serves as a central state/config file guiding development and migration planning.
